Whitespace-only input is effectively missing data.

input.ingredients_text: Sug@r, P@lm 0il, H@z3lnuts (13%), Sk1mm3d m1lk p0wd3r (8.7%), C0c0@, S0y@ l3c1th1n

note: KNOWN LIMITATION (see risk checklist): heavy character-substitution noise can make the vector-search fallback match the WRONG ingredient entirely (e.g. 'Sk1mm3d m1lk p0wd3r' -> 'vitamin d3' by embedding distance, not 'skimmed milk powder'), which can under-classify the diet category even though the ingredient still correctly lands in non_vegan_ingredients. This case intentionally only asserts 'does not crash', not 'gets the category right' — tightening it is exactly the guardrail this evaluation harness exists to add once the aggregation bug is fixed.
